entities.name: Mary, Mother of Jesus
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mother of Jesus, a central figure in Christianity and venerated in Islam. The Annunciation, Nativity, and Magnificat (Luke 1:46-55) establish her as the model of faith and obedience. Venerated as Theotokos ("God-bearer") in the Orthodox and Catholic traditions.
